# Pull Request

## Description

Describe the change and its bounded scope.

## Type of Change

- Feature
- Fix
- Refactor
- Documentation
- Governance
- Infrastructure

## Related Issues

Reference issue IDs or governance records.

## Specification Reference

List source volumes, decision records, implementation cards, and authorization records.

## AI Generation Disclosure

State whether AI assisted with this change and identify reviewed generated artifacts.

## Checklist

- Scope matches approved implementation unit or governance task.
- Registry references are valid.
- Traceability has been updated when required.
- Decision records are referenced when applicable.
- Tests or validation commands have been run.
- Documentation has been updated when required.
- No unauthorized implementation scope is included.
